variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, extra long-slender grain, aromatic variety grown extensively in irrigated lowland. Developed by IARI and released in 2005. Good cooking and eating quality. Suitable for multiple cropping system in Northern India. Tolerant to important diseases and insect pests. Tolerant to lodging and shattering.
